name: Michalis Hadjipantela - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on Parliament’s estimates of revenue and expenditure for the financial year 2027
part_text:
The European Parliament has set its own spending plan for 2027 at about 2.66 billion euros, 1.98 percent more than in 2026. Almost two-thirds of that money is fixed by law, mainly salaries and pensions. The plan adds money for cybersecurity, artificial intelligence and building renovation, and cuts spending on some items such as furniture, translation and visitor centres. It also asks for cheaper housing help for trainees in Luxembourg and better childcare in Strasbourg. Parliament does not ask for any new staff posts.

- Parliament's 2027 budget rises 1.98 percent to 2.66 billion euros, with no new posts.
- It affects members, staff, trainees and visitors through spending on security, buildings and services.
- Parliament will now send these estimates to the Council and the Commission for the budget talks.
